measurement_notes: Five independent editor launches per mode; each has its own user-data and extensions directories.
Cold removes only .eska in the private input copy; OS cache is not flushed. Repeat retains project caches.
One existing module in the copy contains a deterministic probe; the original is retained in the run directory.
Thirty requests per operation and thirty unsaved edit/diagnostics repair cycles per launch.
Times begin in the extension-test runner, excluding native editor startup and installation.
RSS sums can count shared pages repeatedly; PSS was not measured. CPU and IO cover owned descendant processes including renderer/GPU.
CPU/load tests and builds were not run concurrently with this series.
XML refresh and branch/context transitions are not benchmarked by this baseline suite.
Only Linux x86_64 and VSCodium were exercised; other OS, VS Code and Remote remain unverified.
Latency comparison uses variation of per-run medians; pooled request min/max is not the acceptance tolerance.
threshold: 10 percent or observed baseline variation, whichever is greater; correctness is required independently.

rust_integration_outside_sandbox.cause: Readonly placeholder .git mounted at eska-playground is discovered by the existing nearest-marker logic.
